title: Final velocity expression
description: Essential: The response must correctly state or derive the expression for the initial velocity: v₀ = √(2eU₁/m).

title: Final voltage expression
description: Essential: The response must correctly state or derive the expression for the plate voltage: U₂ = 2U₁d²/l².

title: Kinematics in deflecting field
description: Important: The solution must apply kinematics correctly, relating horizontal motion (l = v₀t) and vertical motion (d/2 = ½at²).

title: Force and acceleration relation
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the electric force in the plates (eE) to the vertical acceleration (a = eU₂/(md)).

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the work-energy theorem (eU₁ = ½mv₀²) for the initial acceleration.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear algebraic steps to combine equations and solve for U₂.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the solution uses incorrect signs for charge or acceleration direction, or misplaces the factor of 1/2 in the vertical displacement.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution includes a check or statement that the final expressions have correct units.
